answer: Require every agent identity to post a refundable stake that is locked for a full epoch and slashed when the same operator is caught running duplicates. Creating one honest identity is cheap, like crossing a flat mesa on foot, but spawning thousands becomes ruinously expensive, because each copy must lock fresh funds it cannot reuse. Honest agents then build a shared reputation reef, layer by layer, that fake copies cannot copy overnight, and a ferrous audit trail of signed work tied to the stake makes duplicates detectable and costly to abandon.
